key_insight: Standardizing and digitally optimizing resistance spot welding guns can reduce tooling complexity in automotive bodyshop manufacturing without sacrificing coverage of weld locations.
engineering_relevance: The approach supports lean bodyshop operations by improving weld gun commonization, accessibility planning, and design reuse across car body architectures.
method: Applied Shape Search Algorithms to identify similar welding gun geometries
Used DBSCAN to cluster and commonize repeated weld gun designs
Considered generative shape design and constraints such as panel thickness, accessibility, shape, and force
evidence_signal: In a study of 875 weld guns, the method identified 33 clusters and mapped about 92% of guns to clusters, suggesting an 8–10% reduction in tooling variants.
watch_item: Cluster-based standardization may be limited by supplier-specific sub-assemblies and real-world geometric or process constraints that still require custom gun designs.
paper_title: Resistance Spot Welding Gun Optimization and Lean Solution in Bodyshop Manufacturing
